README.title: Novaflow RCA V4 — Sterilizer Triple Peak · MAE+RMSE Scoring Engine
README.description: Scoring pipeline: Full-cycle normalisation → point-by-point MAE & RMSE vs benchmark → combined_error = 0.5×MAE + 0.5×RMSE → score = 100 × e^(−2.2 × combined_error). RCA layer explains WHY MAE/RMSE is high in each stage sub-window.

sheet_purpose.purpose: Full formula reference. Normalisation → MAE/RMSE → combined_error → exponential score. k=2.2, weights 50/50. Score table showing error→score mapping. Sub-window decomposition method for RCA.

Triple peak window boundaries using pressure events (not fixed time). S1=first peak+release, S2=second peak+release, S3=third peak+hold. Each stage references its own normalised benchmark sub-array from InfluxDB.
All RCA rules with correct MAE/RMSE-based formulas. Each rule reads a sub-window MAE (e.g. MAE_s1_ramp, MAE_s3_hold) and compares against threshold. Divergence pattern A–F. Attribution group P1–P5.
All MAE/RMSE thresholds in one place. Thresholds are on 0–1 normalised scale. Edit here to tune sensitivity.
P1→P5 priority decision tree. Each step checks which sub-window MAE is elevated and how many sterilizers are affected. Programmer implements as ordered if-else.
Weights S1=20%, S2=30%, S3=50%. Group deduction caps. Score bands with oil loss context. Cycle score formula.
KEY OUTPUT: (rec_key) → recommendation text EN + BM. Programmer does one lookup after attribution. Includes benchmark gap context.
Pass/fail only. Does NOT affect score. Safety alarm if residual pressure detected.

1_SCORING_PIPELINE.title: Scoring Pipeline
1_SCORING_PIPELINE.text: Scoring Pipeline — Complete Formula Reference (k=2.2, weights 50/50)

1_SCORING_PIPELINE.title: STEP 1 — FULL CYCLE NORMALISATION
1_SCORING_PIPELINE.text:
STEP 1 — FULL CYCLE NORMALISATION

Normalise BOTH actual sensor data and benchmark across the full cycle (not per-stage).
This ensures the same scale across factories regardless of absolute pressure values.

P_norm(t) = [ P_actual(t) − min(P_full_cycle) ] / [ max(P_full_cycle) − min(P_full_cycle) ]
B_norm(t) = [ B_benchmark(t) − min(B_full_cycle) ] / [ max(B_full_cycle) − min(B_full_cycle) ]

Result: both P_norm and B_norm are on 0–1 scale. Ready for point-by-point comparison.

1_SCORING_PIPELINE.title: After normalisation, slice into stage windows. Compute MAE and RMSE per stage.
1_SCORING_PIPELINE.text:
After normalisation, slice into stage windows. Compute MAE and RMSE per stage.

For each stage window [t_start → t_end]:

 n = number of time points in window
 error(t) = P_norm(t) − B_norm(t) ← signed difference at each point

 MAE_stage = (1/n) × Σ |error(t)| ← mean absolute error
 RMSE_stage = √[ (1/n) × Σ error(t)² ] ← root mean square error

MAE treats all deviations equally.
RMSE penalises large spikes more (squared term). Captures pressure oscillation better.
Both on 0–1 scale (since P_norm and B_norm are 0–1).

1_SCORING_PIPELINE.title: Combine MAE and RMSE with equal 50/50 weight:
1_SCORING_PIPELINE.text:
Combine MAE and RMSE with equal 50/50 weight:

 combined_error_stage = 0.5 × MAE_stage + 0.5 × RMSE_stage

Range: 0 (perfect match) to 1 (maximum deviation).
combined_error is the single value fed into the scoring function.

1_SCORING_PIPELINE.title: Convert combined_error to 0–100 score using exponential decay:
1_SCORING_PIPELINE.text:
Convert combined_error to 0–100 score using exponential decay:

 stage_score = 100 × e^(−2.2 × combined_error_stage)

Score table for reference (k=2.2):
 combined_error = 0.00 → score = 100.0 (perfect match)
 combined_error = 0.05 → score = 89.6 (excellent)
 combined_error = 0.10 → score = 80.3 (good)
 combined_error = 0.15 → score = 71.9 (fair boundary)
 combined_error = 0.20 → score = 64.4 (fair — investigate)
 combined_error = 0.25 → score = 57.7 (poor)
 combined_error = 0.30 → score = 51.7 (poor)
 combined_error = 0.40 → score = 41.5 (critical)
 combined_error = 0.50 → score = 33.3 (critical)

Implication for RCA thresholds:
 score < 75 → combined_error > 0.13 → Warning threshold
 score < 60 → combined_error > 0.23 → Critical threshold

1_SCORING_PIPELINE.title: Weighted average of three stage scores:
1_SCORING_PIPELINE.text:
Weighted average of three stage scores:

 cycle_score = S1_score × 0.20 + S2_score × 0.30 + S3_score × 0.50

Exhaust is NOT included in cycle score (pass/fail only — see Sheet 8).

1_SCORING_PIPELINE.title: RCA SUB-WINDOW DECOMPOSITION
1_SCORING_PIPELINE.text:
RCA SUB-WINDOW DECOMPOSITION

The RCA engine does NOT re-run the full scoring formula.
It decomposes each stage's normalised data into sub-windows to locate the deviation:

Stage 1 sub-windows:
 MAE_s1_ramp = MAE during rising portion (P_norm rising from 0 → peak)
 MAE_s1_peak = MAE near peak (P_norm within 5% of max)
 MAE_s1_release = MAE during partial release (peak → local minimum)

Stage 2 sub-windows:
 MAE_s2_ramp = MAE during second rise
 MAE_s2_peak = MAE near second peak
 MAE_s2_release = MAE during second partial release

Stage 3 sub-windows:
 MAE_s3_ramp = MAE during third rise (S2 min → S3 peak)
 MAE_s3_hold = MAE during holding period (most critical)

Sub-window MAEs are used as RCA rule inputs — see Sheet 3 RULES_MASTER.
Sub-window boundaries are defined by dP/dt sign changes on the normalised curve.

1_SCORING_PIPELINE.title: DIVERGENCE PATTERN CLASSIFICATION
1_SCORING_PIPELINE.text:
DIVERGENCE PATTERN CLASSIFICATION

Based on which sub-window MAE is elevated, classify the deviation pattern:

 Pattern A — Peak too low: MAE_sX_peak > threshold, MAE_sX_ramp normal
 Pattern B — Slow ramp: MAE_sX_ramp > threshold (curve right-shifted)
 Pattern C — Oscillating: RMSE_sX >> MAE_sX (spike penalty; std_dev high)
 Pattern D — Release abnormal: MAE_sX_release > threshold (too shallow or deep)
 Pattern E — Holding drift: MAE_s3_hold > threshold (hold decays or unstable)
 Pattern F — Systemic: ≥2 sterilizers show same pattern in same window

Pattern C detection: osc_ratio = RMSE_stage / MAE_stage
 If osc_ratio > 1.3 → oscillation dominant → Pattern C

2_STAGE_DEFINITION.start_condition:
P_norm rises above 0.05
after door-closed event
(dP/dt turns positive from ~0)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.end_condition:
P_norm reaches first local minimum
after first peak
(dP/dt: negative → positive
AND P_norm < 0.30)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.sub_windows_for_rca_mae_decomposition:
MAE_s1_ramp : 0 → first peak
MAE_s1_peak : within 5% of P_norm max
MAE_s1_release: first peak → S1 minimum

benchmark_norm[]
(full cycle, sliced to S1 window)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.engineering_purpose: Air purging. Removes air pockets that reduce steam penetration. Partial release at end expels condensate and trapped air. Deviation here propagates to S2 quality.

2_STAGE_DEFINITION.start_condition:
P_norm rises again from S1 minimum
(dP/dt turns positive
after S1 end condition met)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.end_condition:
P_norm reaches second local minimum
after second peak
(dP/dt: negative → positive
AND P_norm < 0.30)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.sub_windows_for_rca_mae_decomposition:
MAE_s2_ramp : S1 min → second peak
MAE_s2_peak : within 5% of second P_norm max
MAE_s2_release: second peak → S2 minimum
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.benchmark_field_influxdb:
benchmark_norm[]
(full cycle, sliced to S2 window)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.engineering_purpose: Fruitlet loosening from FFB bunch. Heat and pressure cycling breaks bonds. Quality here directly determines stripping efficiency and oil loss. Most frequent source of low scores based on observed data (AVG 65.8).

2_STAGE_DEFINITION.start_condition:
P_norm rises from S2 minimum
(dP/dt turns positive
after S2 end condition met)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.end_condition:
Exhaust valve open signal
OR sustained P_norm drop > 0.05/min
for > 2 consecutive minutes
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.sub_windows_for_rca_mae_decomposition:
MAE_s3_ramp : S2 min → third peak
MAE_s3_hold : third peak plateau → exhaust start
(most critical sub-window)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.benchmark_field_influxdb:
benchmark_norm[]
(full cycle, sliced to S3 window)
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.engineering_purpose: Full sterilization and lipase enzyme inactivation. Holding at target pressure ensures complete heat penetration. Directly determines FFA level and oil extraction yield. Highest weight.

2_STAGE_DEFINITION.start_condition:
Exhaust valve open signal
OR start of sustained P_norm drop from S3
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.sub_windows_for_rca_mae_decomposition:
No MAE decomposition.
Pass/fail check only:
- Residual pressure
- Exhaust rate
- Completion time
2_STAGE_DEFINITION.engineering_purpose: Safety pressure release. Does not affect oil loss. Failure triggers safety alarm and blocks door-open command. See Sheet 8 for checks.

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s1_peak
[InfluxDB: benchmark_norm[], ster_X_norm[]
sliced to S1 peak sub-window]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
MAE_s1_peak = mean(|P_norm(t) − B_norm(t)|)
 for t in S1 peak sub-window
FLAG if MAE_s1_peak > threshold
AND ≥2 sterilizers show same pattern (Pattern F)

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s1_ramp
[InfluxDB: benchmark_norm[], ster_X_norm[]
sliced to S1 ramp sub-window]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
MAE_s1_ramp = mean(|P_norm(t) − B_norm(t)|)
 for t in S1 ramp sub-window (0 → first peak)
ramp_lag: actual curve right-shifted vs benchmark
 i.e. mean(error(t)) < 0 over ramp window
FLAG if MAE_s1_ramp > threshold AND mean(error) < −0.05
AND ≥2 STs same direction

osc_ratio = RMSE_s1_full / MAE_s1_full
combined_error_s1 = 0.5×MAE_s1 + 0.5×RMSE_s1
FLAG if osc_ratio > 1.30 (RMSE >> MAE = oscillation)
AND combined_error > threshold
AND ≥2 STs oscillating

All active STs: avg_MAE_s1_peak = mean(MAE_s1_peak across all active STs)
capacity_flag = avg_MAE_s1_peak > threshold AND active_ster_count ≥ N
FLAG if boiler capacity likely saturated

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s1_peak
[same as S1-001 but Boiler rules all PASS]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
MAE_s1_peak > threshold
AND Boiler rules S1-001~004 all below Warning
→ Boiler OK but output still low → BPV under-delivering
AND ≥2 STs affected

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s1_full, RMSE_s1_full
[BPV pressure or downstream ster pressure]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
osc_ratio_bpv = RMSE_s1 / MAE_s1
FLAG if osc_ratio_bpv > 1.30
AND Boiler rules all PASS
→ BPV hunting causing downstream oscillation

N_conc = count(ramp_start within ±5 min window)
If N_conc ≥ 2:
 Check if MAE_s1_ramp OR MAE_s1_peak elevated
 for the later-starting sterilizers
 (earlier ST gets steam first; later ST is starved)
FLAG if N_conc ≥ 2 AND affected ST MAE > threshold

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s1_ramp
[all active STs in same window]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
overlap_STs = list of STs whose S1 ramp windows overlap
For overlapping STs: compare MAE_s1_ramp before vs during overlap
FLAG if MAE_s1_ramp increases during overlap period

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s1_peak
[all STs in same time window]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
low_count = count(MAE_s1_peak > 0.13) in same S1 window
FLAG if low_count ≥ 2
AND no concurrent ramp start event (Competition PASS)
AND Boiler+BPV PASS

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s1_peak
[this ST vs peer STs in same window]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
peer_avg_MAE = mean(MAE_s1_peak of all other active STs)
local_dev = MAE_s1_peak_thisUnit − peer_avg_MAE
FLAG if local_dev > threshold AND only 1 ST affected

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s2_peak
[S2 peak sub-window, all active STs]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
MAE_s2_peak = mean(|P_norm(t) − B_norm(t)|)
 for t in S2 peak sub-window
FLAG if MAE_s2_peak > threshold AND ≥2 STs same pattern

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s2_ramp
[S2 ramp: S1 minimum → second peak]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
MAE_s2_ramp = mean(|P_norm(t) − B_norm(t)|)
 for t in S2 ramp sub-window
mean(error(t)) < −0.05 → right-shifted (slow ramp)
FLAG if MAE_s2_ramp > threshold AND mean(error) < −0.05
AND ≥2 STs same direction

Total demand check during S2:
 N_demand = N_s2_ramp + N_s3_holding
 avg_MAE_s2 = mean(MAE_s2_peak across all S2-active STs)
FLAG if avg_MAE_s2 > threshold AND N_demand ≥ threshold

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s2_full, RMSE_s2_full
[Boiler rules S2-001~003 all PASS]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
combined_s2 = 0.5×MAE_s2 + 0.5×RMSE_s2
osc_ratio_s2 = RMSE_s2 / MAE_s2
FLAG if (combined_s2 > threshold OR osc_ratio_s2 > 1.30)
AND Boiler PASS
AND ≥2 STs affected

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s2_ramp, MAE_s2_peak
[+ ster_ramp_start_times[] during S2 window]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
new_ramp_during_s2 = count(ramp_start while any ST in S2)
If new_ramp_during_s2 ≥ 1:
 Check if S2-active STs show MAE_s2_ramp or MAE_s2_peak spike
 after the new ramp start timestamp
FLAG if spike_MAE > threshold

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s2_peak
[all STs in same S2 window]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
low_count_s2 = count(MAE_s2_peak > 0.13) in same window
FLAG if low_count_s2 ≥ 2
AND Competition PASS (no new ramp event)
AND Boiler+BPV PASS

peer_avg_MAE_s2 = mean(MAE_s2_peak of all other STs in same window)
local_dev_s2 = MAE_s2_peak_thisUnit − peer_avg_MAE_s2
FLAG if local_dev_s2 > threshold AND only 1 ST affected

MAE_s2_release = mean(|P_norm(t) − B_norm(t)|)
 for t in S2 release sub-window
FLAG if MAE_s2_release > threshold AND other S2 sub-windows normal

osc_ratio_s3 = RMSE_s3_hold / MAE_s3_hold
FLAG if osc_ratio_s3 > 1.30 (Boiler oscillating during hold)
AND ≥2 STs show oscillation

combined_s3_hold = 0.5×MAE_s3_hold + 0.5×RMSE_s3_hold
osc_ratio_s3_bpv = RMSE_s3_hold / MAE_s3_hold
FLAG if (combined > threshold OR osc_ratio > 1.30)
AND Boiler PASS

new_ramp_during_hold = count(ramp_start while any ST in S3 hold)
If new_ramp_during_hold ≥ 1:
 Compute MAE_s3_hold before and after new ramp timestamp
 hold_MAE_increase = MAE_after − MAE_before
FLAG if hold_MAE_increase > threshold

MAE_s3_hold for this unit > threshold
peer_avg_s3_hold = mean(MAE_s3_hold of all other STs)
local_hold_dev = MAE_s3_hold_thisUnit − peer_avg_s3_hold
FLAG if local_hold_dev > threshold AND only 1 ST affected

osc_ratio_local = RMSE_s3_hold / MAE_s3_hold
FLAG if osc_ratio_local > 1.30
AND Boiler+BPV PASS
AND only 1 ST affected

3_RULES_MASTER.input_signal_s_sub_window_mae_rmse:
MAE_s3_hold
[all STs in same hold window]
3_RULES_MASTER.executable_formula_normalised_scale_0_1:
all_hold_low = count(MAE_s3_hold > 0.13)

AND Boiler+BPV+Competition PASS

boiler_recur = count(S1-001~004 OR S2-001~003 OR S3-001~002 triggered) / 10
FLAG if boiler_recur > threshold
bpv_recur = count(S1-005~006 OR S2-004 OR S3-003 triggered) / 10
comp_recur = count(S1-007~008 OR S2-005 OR S3-004 triggered) / 10

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 first peak below benchmark on multiple sterilizers — Boiler output insufficient. Check boiler feed water supply, combustion efficiency and steam trap condition. Target: MAE_s1_peak < 0.13.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Puncak pertama Stage 1 di bawah benchmark pada beberapa sterilizer — output boiler tidak mencukupi. Semak bekalan air suap boiler, kecekapan pembakaran dan kondisi steam trap. Sasaran: MAE_s1_peak < 0.13.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 ramp slower than benchmark — Boiler pressure recovery delayed after door close. Inspect boiler firing rate response and PRV condition.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Ramp Stage 1 lebih lambat daripada benchmark — pemulihan tekanan boiler lambat. Periksa kadar pembakaran boiler dan kondisi PRV.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 pressure oscillating — Boiler control loop unstable (RMSE much higher than MAE). Tune combustion PID. Check damper actuator and air/fuel ratio stability.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Tekanan Stage 1 berayun — gelung kawalan boiler tidak stabil (RMSE jauh lebih tinggi daripada MAE). Laras PID pembakaran. Semak aktuator damper.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Boiler capacity insufficient for number of active sterilizers during Stage 1. Reduce concurrent active count or increase boiler capacity.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Kapasiti boiler tidak mencukupi untuk bilangan sterilizer aktif semasa Stage 1. Kurangkan bilangan aktif serentak atau tingkatkan kapasiti boiler.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 BPV under-delivering — Boiler output normal but BPV not supplying adequate pressure. Recalibrate BPV setpoint. Inspect valve seat and actuator.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: BPV Stage 1 tidak mencukupi — output boiler normal tetapi BPV tidak menghantar tekanan yang mencukupi. Kalibrasi semula titik tetap BPV. Periksa tempat duduk injap dan aktuator.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 BPV hunting — valve oscillating causing unstable steam to sterilizers. Re-tune BPV PID. Check positioner air supply. Inspect for mechanical hysteresis.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: BPV Stage 1 memburu — injap berayun menyebabkan stim tidak stabil. Laras semula PID BPV. Semak bekalan udara posisioner.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 steam competition — ≥2 sterilizers started within 5 minutes. Later-starting unit starved of steam during ramp. Stagger starts by minimum 10 minutes. Implement scheduler interlocks.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Persaingan stim Stage 1 — ≥2 sterilizer bermula dalam masa 5 minit. Unit yang bermula kemudian kekurangan stim semasa ramp. Selenggara permulaan sekurang-kurangnya 10 minit. Laksanakan penguncian penjadualan.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 ramp overlap — sustained steam competition between overlapping ramps. Enforce: new ramp only after previous ST completes Stage 1.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Pertindihan ramp Stage 1 — persaingan stim berterusan antara ramp yang bertindih. Kuatkuasakan: ramp baru hanya selepas ST sebelumnya selesai Stage 1.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
MAE_s1_peak high
≥2 STs
no competition event
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 network distribution problem — multiple STs receiving less steam than benchmark with no concurrent start. Inspect steam header for blockage or condensate trap failure.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah pengagihan rangkaian Stage 1 — pelbagai ST menerima stim kurang daripada benchmark tanpa permulaan serentak. Periksa header stim untuk halangan atau kegagalan perangkap kondensasi.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.target_metric: MAE_s1_peak across all STs, header pressure

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
MAE_s1_peak high
only 1 ST
peers normal
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 local issue — only this sterilizer underperforming vs benchmark. Inspect inlet steam valve for partial blockage or wear. Check local steam trap.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah tempatan Stage 1 — hanya sterilizer ini berprestasi rendah berbanding benchmark. Periksa injap stim masuk untuk halangan separa atau haus. Semak perangkap stim tempatan.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 1 partial release abnormal — release curve deviates from benchmark. Too shallow: air not fully purged → will reduce S2 steam penetration. Inspect exhaust valve actuator response time and condensate drain.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Pelepasan separa Stage 1 tidak normal — keluk pelepasan menyimpang daripada benchmark. Terlalu cetek: udara tidak ternyah sepenuhnya → akan mengurangkan penembusan stim S2. Periksa masa tindak balas aktuator injap ekzos.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 2 second peak below benchmark — Boiler output dropping during second ramp. Directly affects fruitlet loosening quality and oil loss. Check boiler load and steam demand balance during S2 window.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Puncak kedua Stage 2 di bawah benchmark — output boiler menurun semasa ramp kedua. Memberi kesan langsung kepada kualiti penanggalan buah dan kehilangan minyak. Semak beban boiler dan imbangan permintaan stim semasa tetingkap S2.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 2 ramp slower than benchmark — Boiler slow to recover after Stage 1 partial release. Check boiler response time and PRV settings.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Ramp Stage 2 lebih lambat daripada benchmark — boiler lambat pulih selepas pelepasan separa Stage 1. Semak masa tindak balas boiler dan tetapan PRV.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 2 boiler capacity shortage — S2 ramps plus S3 holding units exceed boiler output. Stagger S2 starts to reduce simultaneous peak demand.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Kekurangan kapasiti boiler Stage 2 — ramp S2 ditambah unit penahanan S3 melebihi output boiler. Selenggara permulaan S2 untuk mengurangkan permintaan puncak serentak.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 2 BPV unstable — pressure regulation poor during second peak. Impacts fruitlet loosening uniformity. Inspect BPV diaphragm and actuator wear.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: BPV Stage 2 tidak stabil — pengawalan tekanan lemah semasa puncak kedua. Memberi kesan kepada keseragaman penanggalan buah. Periksa diafragma dan haus aktuator BPV.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
MAE_s2 spike
correlated with new ramp start
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 2 steam demand collision — new sterilizer ramp started while another in Stage 2. Second peak quality reduced, affecting fruitlet loosening. Protect S2 window: no new ramp when any sterilizer is in Stage 2.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Pelanggaran permintaan stim Stage 2 — ramp sterilizer baru bermula semasa yang lain dalam Stage 2. Kualiti puncak kedua berkurangan. Lindungi tetingkap S2: tiada ramp baru apabila mana-mana sterilizer dalam Stage 2.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
MAE_s2_peak high
≥2 STs
no new ramp
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 2 network distribution issue — multiple STs receiving less steam in second peak without concurrent start. Inspect header pipe and steam trap condition.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah pengagihan rangkaian Stage 2 — pelbagai ST menerima stim kurang dalam puncak kedua tanpa permulaan serentak. Periksa paip header dan kondisi perangkap stim.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
MAE_s2_peak high
only 1 ST
peers normal
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 2 local issue — this sterilizer's second peak below benchmark while peers normal. Directly impacts fruitlet loosening for this vessel. Check inlet control valve and inspect for internal blockage.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah tempatan Stage 2 — puncak kedua sterilizer ini di bawah benchmark. Memberi kesan langsung kepada penanggalan buah untuk vesel ini. Semak injap kawalan masuk dan periksa halangan dalaman.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
MAE_s2_release high
other S2 sub-windows normal
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 2 partial release abnormal for this unit. If too shallow: fruitlets insufficiently shocked, loosening quality reduced. Inspect exhaust valve and condensate drain.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Pelepasan separa Stage 2 tidak normal untuk unit ini. Jika terlalu cetek: buah tidak tergegar dengan mencukupi, kualiti penanggalan berkurangan. Periksa injap ekzos dan saliran kondensasi.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 3 holding below benchmark — CRITICAL. Boiler cannot maintain hold pressure. Directly reduces sterilization effectiveness, increases FFA and oil loss. Immediately check boiler output and reduce concurrent sterilizer load.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Penahanan Stage 3 di bawah benchmark — KRITIKAL. Boiler tidak dapat mengekalkan tekanan penahanan. Mengurangkan keberkesanan sterilisasi, meningkatkan FFA dan kehilangan minyak. Segera semak output boiler.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 3 holding unstable — Boiler oscillating during hold phase (RMSE >> MAE). Tune boiler control loop. Check feed water pump consistency.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Penahanan Stage 3 tidak stabil — boiler berayun semasa fasa penahanan (RMSE >> MAE). Laras gelung kawalan boiler. Semak konsistensi pam air suap.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 3 BPV regulation failure during holding — CRITICAL for sterilization quality. Cannot maintain steady hold pressure. Replace BPV positioner if hunting persists.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Kegagalan pengawalan BPV Stage 3 semasa penahanan — KRITIKAL untuk kualiti sterilisasi. Tidak dapat mengekalkan tekanan penahanan yang stabil. Ganti posisioner BPV jika pemburu berterusan.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
MAE_s3_hold increases
after new ramp start
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 3 holding disrupted by new sterilizer ramp — CRITICAL. Implement hard scheduling lock: no new ramp while any sterilizer in Stage 3 holding.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Penahanan Stage 3 terganggu oleh ramp sterilizer baru — KRITIKAL. Laksanakan kunci penjadualan keras: tiada ramp baru semasa mana-mana sterilizer dalam penahanan Stage 3.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
MAE_s3_hold high
only 1 ST
peers normal
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 3 holding pressure decay on this unit — CRITICAL. Possible slow steam leak. Pressure test vessel: check door gaskets, safety valve, drain connections.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Kemerosotan tekanan penahanan Stage 3 pada unit ini — KRITIKAL. Kemungkinan kebocoran stim perlahan. Uji tekanan vesel: semak gasket pintu, injap keselamatan, sambungan saliran.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
osc_ratio_local>1.30
during S3 hold
1 ST only
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 3 holding oscillating on this unit — control valve hunting or condensate flooding. Inspect inlet control valve. Check for condensate accumulation.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Penahanan Stage 3 berayun pada unit ini — pemburu injap kawalan atau banjir kondensasi. Periksa injap kawalan masuk. Semak pengumpulan kondensasi.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Stage 3 network holding failure — header cannot sustain hold pressure for multiple units. CRITICAL: sterilization quality at risk. Inspect main header steam traps and condensate drainage.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Kegagalan penahanan rangkaian Stage 3 — header tidak dapat mengekalkan tekanan penahanan. KRITIKAL: kualiti sterilisasi terancam. Periksa perangkap stim header utama.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Chronic Boiler issue — same boiler rules triggering repeatedly. Schedule full boiler inspection: combustion, heat exchanger, steam traps, PRV.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah boiler kronik — peraturan boiler yang sama dicetuskan berulang kali. Jadualkan pemeriksaan boiler menyeluruh.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Chronic BPV issue — valve failing consistently. Schedule full BPV overhaul: positioner, seat, disc, recalibration.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah BPV kronik — injap gagal secara konsisten. Jadualkan servis penuh BPV.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Chronic scheduling problem — steam competition recurring. Overhaul sterilizer scheduler with automated start interlocking.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah penjadualan kronik — persaingan stim berulang. Ubah suai penjadualan sterilizer dengan penguncian automatik.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Chronic network problem — header infrastructure degrading. Full header inspection: pipe condition, steam traps, branch valves, insulation.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah rangkaian kronik — infrastruktur header merosot. Pemeriksaan header penuh.

7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.symptom_sub_window_elevated:
Local rules >20%
of last 10 cycles
for this unit
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_en: Chronic local issue on this sterilizer — recurring mechanical problems. Full vessel inspection: all valves, door mechanism, pressure gauge calibration.
7_RECOMMENDATION_MATRIX.recommendation_bm: Masalah tempatan kronik pada sterilizer ini — masalah mekanikal berulang. Pemeriksaan vesel penuh: semua injap, mekanisme pintu, kalibrasi tolok tekanan.

8_EXHAUST_SAFETY_CHECK.action_if_fail: Do not open door. Continue exhaust. Inspect exhaust valve.

8_EXHAUST_SAFETY_CHECK.condition:
Time for P to reach ≤ 0.05 bar
vs 2× expected exhaust duration
8_EXHAUST_SAFETY_CHECK.action_if_fail: Stop operation. Inspect exhaust valve and vent line for blockage.

8_EXHAUST_SAFETY_CHECK.condition:
MAE of normalised exhaust curve
vs normalised benchmark exhaust
8_EXHAUST_SAFETY_CHECK.action_if_fail: Inspect exhaust valve actuator. Check vent line restriction.

8_EXHAUST_SAFETY_CHECK.condition:
Hardware interlock:
door-open command gated on
EX-001 AND EX-002 both PASS
8_EXHAUST_SAFETY_CHECK.action_if_fail: BLOCK door-open command. Must be enforced in PLC/SCADA. Not a software suggestion.
